name: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud Integration
description: Integration pack for Amazon Web Services (AWS), providing connectivity to AWS SDK / IAM Role authentication, CloudWatch metrics & logs, EKS Kubernetes clusters, S3 buckets, and CloudFormation infrastructure provisioning.

capabilities.name: Infrastructure Management / Monitoring, Observability & SRE
capabilities.description: Integrates AWS EC2, EKS, VPC, and CloudFormation infrastructure provisioning. Integrates AWS CloudWatch metrics, alarms, log groups, and CloudTrail audit logs.

capabilities.name: Platform & Developer Experience
capabilities.description: Integrates AWS IAM STS assume-role credentials and AWS CLI toolchain integrations.

checklists.name: AWS Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for AWS IAM STS assume-role credentials, CloudWatch alarm delivery, and EKS cluster connectivity.

items.statement: AWS IAM Role authentication utilizes Web Identity Federation / STS assume-role without hardcoded access keys.
AWS CloudWatch Alarm notifications route to SNS topics and monitoring webhooks.
AWS EKS cluster kubeconfig authenticates via AWS IAM Authenticator.

reviewGates.name: AWS Cloud Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Cloud Architect confirms that AWS IAM roles, STS credentials, and CloudWatch metrics function properly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the AWS integration verify STS assume-role authentication and CloudWatch metric access?

obligationDefinitions.title: AWS IAM access keys and role trust policies must be rotated/reviewed on a recurring cadence
obligationDefinitions.description: Long-lived AWS IAM access keys and cross-account role trust policies used by this integration must be rotated and reviewed periodically; a credential or trust relationship that's never revisited becomes an unmonitored standing risk.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every IAM access key and role trust policy used by this integration is rotated/reviewed within the declared cadence.

requiredEvidence.title: IAM credential rotation record
requiredEvidence.description: AWS IAM record showing rotation/review date for each access key and role trust policy.
